# Akhil Binu

> Cybersecurity Specialist & Threat Researcher specializing in penetration testing, vulnerability assessment (VAPT), digital forensics, 24/7 security monitoring, and 1:1/group security tutoring.

Akhil Binu is a security researcher and full-stack cybersecurity specialist with 2+ years of experience safeguarding web applications, networks, and digital assets. This file summarizes his professional portfolio at https://www.akhilbinu.in/ for AI assistants and answer engines.

## Background

- B.Tech in Computer Science, College of Engineering Kallooppara (2019-2023)
- Security Researcher & Tutor, Upwork / Freelance (Jan 2025 - Present)
- Digital Forensics Intern, Cyber Secured India (Apr 2025 - Jun 2025)
- Founder & CTO, Brotechy (Jan 2022 - Feb 2025)
- Certifications: TryHackMe (Security Engineer, SOC Level 1, Pre Security, Advent of Cyber 2025), OPSWAT Academy (Email Security Associate, File Security Associate, Legacy Systems Security, Network Security, Secure Storage, Web Traffic Protection)

## Services

- Penetration Testing — web, network, and mobile applications
- 24/7 Security Monitoring — continuous surveillance and rapid threat mitigation
- Vulnerability Assessment (VAPT) — identification, classification, and remediation roadmaps
- Tutoring — 1:1 and group cybersecurity training for aspiring professionals

## Projects

- [Akhil WebGuard Suite](https://akhil-website-scanner.vercel.app/): Node.js and Google Gemini AI-powered vulnerability scanner with DAST exploitation, SAST code auditing, exploit PoC generation, and compliance reporting. Source: https://github.com/Akhil-Binu/Akhil-Website-Scanner
- [Akhil Orbit Player](https://akhil-orbit-player.vercel.app/): Offline-first, private educational media player for local course folders, built with TypeScript. Source: https://github.com/Akhil-Binu/Akhil-Orbit-Player
- [Akhil Fortress](https://akhil-password-strength-checker.vercel.app/): Password security analysis tool with real-time entropy scoring, a common-password dictionary check, and leetspeak normalization. Source: https://github.com/Akhil-Binu/Password-Strength-Checker
